scenarios.reasoning: The agent followed a reasonable investigation path and correctly identified the error (MSB3030, missing ApplicationManifest.xml), but got the key finding wrong - it stated LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when it apparently was not. This fundamental misidentification meant the agent couldn't provide the correct root cause analysis. The agent was misled by tool output (binlog_projects listing referenced projects) and didn't dig deeper to verify actual build execution status.
